# Use-Case Model

## Actors and Goals

| **Actor**                   | **Type** | **Goal**                                                                              |
| --------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| UB Student                  | Primary  | Apply for university accommodation and know their application/allocation status.      |
| Accommodation Administrator | Primary  | Process accommodation applications and manage room allocations and residence records. |
| System Administrator        | Primary  | Manage system user accounts and role-based permissions.                               |
| Residence Hall Wardens      | Primary  | See accurate, current occupancy for their residence.                                  |
| Residence Staff             | Primary  | Manage applications ,rooms,capacity and allocation efficiently.                       |

## Use Cases

| **ID** | **Use Case**            | **Primary Actor**           |
| ------ | ----------------------- | --------------------------- |
| UC-01  | Apply for Accommodation | Student                     |
| UC-02  | View Application Status | Student                     |
| UC-03  | Review Application      | Accommodation Administrator |
| UC-04  | Allocate Room           | Accommodation Administrator |
| UC-05  | Reject Application      | Accommodation Administrator |
| UC-06  | Manage Rooms            | Accommodation Administrator |
| UC-07  | Manage User Accounts    | System Administrator        |
| UC-08  | Log In                  | Student                     |
| UC-09  | View System Reports     | System Administrator        |
| UC-10  | Update room Occupancy   | Hall Warden                 |

**System boundary: UB Student Accommodation System.**

UC-01 is the fully dressed core use case, covering the vertical slice: submission → review → allocation/rejection → status update.
